result.title: Get started with ChatGPT Work
result.description:
ChatGPT Work gives you one place to delegate real work across your apps, files, local projects, browser, and computer. It works across web, mobile, and the new ChatGPT desktop app.

In this walkthrough, see how to connect your tools, set up recurring work, move between devices, and collaborate with ChatGPT as it works toward an outcome.

Get started: https://learn.chatgpt.com/
